findings.location: task.hints[kind=translation].targets: []; its block contains the complete answer «¿Puedes ayudarme? — Можеш мені допомогти?».
findings.description: This hint supplies the complete assessed construction, just as the reveal hint does, but records no target support. It is more than a vocabulary gloss.
findings.suggestion: Assign formula.request-puedes/construction-use to this hint, or replace its contents with a vocabulary-only gloss such as «ayudar — допомагати» and retain an empty targets list.

items.notes: The answer key is correct. A model is permitted in this supported task.

findings.location: task.options[id=a].feedbackUk: «Quise — минулий час про одну подію.»
findings.description: The explanation misleadingly defines the preterite by event count. It can describe bounded states and repeated occurrences; a constructed counterexample is «Varias veces quise llamarte». The relevant distinction here is past reference versus the courtesy use of quería.
findings.suggestion: Replace the sentence with «Quise — форма простого минулого часу від querer. Тут потрібне quería як ввічливе теперішнє прохання.»

items.notes: Option c is correctly keyed. Recognizing the taught quería does not require mastery of the subjunctive distractor quiera.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, chapter 23, treatment of perfective aspect and pretérito perfecto simple (from memory).

findings.location: task.prompt[0].text: «На вулиці ви звертаєтеся по допомогу до незнайомої літньої жінки. Яке прохання доречне?»; task.options[id=b].outcomes marks «Señora, ¿puedes ayudarme?» incorrect.
findings.description: Age and unfamiliarity favour usted but do not establish an obligatory treatment throughout Spain. Señora reinforces the formal reading, yet the prompt does not explicitly say that formal address is required. The key turns a contextual preference into a categorical rejection.
findings.suggestion: Clarify that the learner is choosing formal, respectful usted address, or ask explicitly for the more conservative formal option. Resolve whether an informal interpretation is intended to be excluded before retaining the categorical key.

items.reviewerAnswer: a is the conventional respectful choice; b depends on whether informal tuteo is appropriate in this interaction.
items.notes: This is a register uncertainty, not a claim that option a is wrong.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, chapter 16, discussion of forms of address and their social conditioning (from memory).
Course contract, verdict definition for underdetermined context or register.

findings.location: task.prompt[0].text: «Ви звертаєтеся до колеги свого віку, з яким працюєте щодня»; task.options[id=a].outcomes marks «¿Puede enviarme el mensaje?» incorrect.
findings.description: Equal age and daily contact do not specify the colleagues' established treatment or workplace register. Tú is common, but usted can remain appropriate in a formal workplace. The feedback's «зазвичай» itself describes a tendency rather than an exclusive answer.
findings.suggestion: Add that these colleagues normally address each other with tú, for example «з яким ви на «ти»», or allow both treatments when the workplace relationship remains unspecified.

items.reviewerAnswer: b for an established tú relationship; a for an established usted relationship. Both readings fit the stated facts.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, chapter 16, discussion of forms of address and their social conditioning (from memory).

findings.location: task.prompt[0].text: «На вокзалі ви звертаєтеся до групи незнайомих літніх туристів»; task.options[id=b].outcomes marks «Perdón, ¿podéis esperar un momento?» incorrect.
findings.description: Being unfamiliar and elderly makes ustedes a reasonable respectful choice but does not rule out informal vosotros in an ordinary Peninsular interaction. The prompt supplies no explicit formal role, institutional convention, or chosen treatment that makes only a acceptable.
findings.suggestion: Specify that the speaker is using formal ustedes address, or explicitly ask which option matches a formal respectful register. Otherwise review both register interpretations.

items.reviewerAnswer: a with formal ustedes address; b with informal Peninsular vosotros address. The preferred register is not explicitly fixed.
